title: Should I take the job?
text:
Hi Marek,

I need your advice! You know I've been looking for a new job for months. Well, yesterday I finally got an offer from a software company in Wrocław. The salary is about thirty percent higher than what I earn now, and they want me to lead a small team of four people. It sounds perfect, doesn't it?

The problem is that I would have to move. My flat in Poznań is only ten minutes from my parents, and since Dad's operation last spring, I go there almost every day to help with shopping and cooking. My sister lives in Gdańsk, so she can't help very often. If I move, Mum will have to do everything herself.

The company says I could work from home two days a week, which would help a bit. Wrocław is about two hours from Poznań by train, so I could come back every weekend. But I'm not sure that would be enough.

On the other hand, I don't want to stay in my current job forever. I've been there for six years, and there's no chance of promotion. I'm bored, and I feel I'm not learning anything new. My manager is nice, but she won't be able to give me more responsibility.

They want an answer by Friday. What would you do if you were me? You always see things more clearly than I do. Can we talk on the phone tonight or tomorrow?

Thanks, and sorry for the long email!
Ania
